title: Purification, identification, and antioxidative mechanism of three novel selenium-enriched oyster antioxidant peptides.
authors: Xia, Zhen; Miao, Jianyin; Chen, Bingbing; Guo, Junbin; Ou, Yingyi; Liang, Xingtang; Yin, Yanzhen; Tong, Xing; Cao, Yong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究硒富集牡蛎抗氧化肽的纯化鉴定及抗氧化机制，涉及肽与Keap1蛋白的分子对接，但对象为蛋白-肽互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Natural organic selenium (Se) has multiple physiological health benefits and has become a hotspot of research in recent years. In this study, the Se-enriched antioxidant peptides were purified from Se-enriched oyster hydrolysate. Three novel Se-enriched antioxidant peptides LLVSeMY (685.2953 Da), MMDSeML (687.1875 Da) and VSeMDSeML (703.1599 Da) were identified from fraction F6-4, which all exhibited strong cellular antioxidant activity (CAA) with EC(50) values of 0.739, 0.423, and 0.395 mug/mL, respectively. These three Se-enriched antioxidant peptides (0.025 mg/mL) could significantly enhanced cell viability to 84.60 +/- 3.32%  approximately  86.18 +/- 1.36% compared with the AAPH injury group (75.99 +/- 0.79%), and the cytoprotective effects were even better than that of GSH (80.47 +/- 2.78%). Moreover, these three Se-enriched peptides also significantly protected HepG2 cells from AAPH-induced oxidative injury by inhibiting ROS production and enhancing the activities of antioxidant enzymes. The molecular docking results showed that these three Se-enriched peptides can form stable hydrogen and hydrophobic bonds with key amino acid residues of Keap1 protein, thereby potentially regulating the Keap1-Nrf2 pathway. In conclusion, the three novel Se-enriched oyster antioxidant peptides are expected to be used in medicine or functional food, providing a new theoretical basis for the high-value utilization of natural organic Se.
abstract_zh: 天然有机硒（Se）具有多种生理健康益处，近年来已成为研究热点。本研究从富硒牡蛎酶解物中纯化出富硒抗氧化肽。从组分F6-4中鉴定出三种新型富硒抗氧化肽LLVSeMY（685.2953 Da）、MMDSeML（687.1875 Da）和VSeMDSeML（703.1599 Da），它们均表现出强细胞抗氧化活性（CAA），EC(50)值分别为0.739、0.423和0.395 μg/mL。这三种富硒抗氧化肽（0.025 mg/mL）能显著将细胞活力提高至84.60 ± 3.32%至86.18 ± 1.36%，而AAPH损伤组为75.99 ± 0.79%，其细胞保护效果甚至优于GSH（80.47 ± 2.78%）。此外，这三种富硒肽还通过抑制ROS产生和增强抗氧化酶活性，显著保护HepG2细胞免受AAPH诱导的氧化损伤。分子对接结果表明，这三种富硒肽能与Keap1蛋白的关键氨基酸残基形成稳定的氢键和疏水键，从而可能调节Keap1-Nrf2通路。总之，这三种新型富硒牡蛎抗氧化肽有望用于医药或功能性食品，为天然有机硒的高值化利用提供新的理论基础。
